response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) as fraction FROM matched GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat ORDER BY (insurstat IS NULL), fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
